Worst burger place in Phu Quoc with terrible service!!
Mar 2025 • Couples
Don’t trust all the positive reviews you read about this place. The food is decent, but also nothing special and very overpriced. Especially the burgers are very overpriced. We have had many better burgers in Vietnam for probably at least 100,000 VND cheaper. The sizes are also very small (a ‘big’ bucket of potato wedges contains just a couple of them), so price-quantity ratio is terrible. I ordered a cocktail, which barely contained any alcohol and my girlfriend ordered a gin cocktail which was not even half-full. The service was truly appalling, no attention or friendliness whatsoever. There are so many better places you can have your dinner in Duong Dong, also very close by. Don’t go here!!
